info.title: MSME AI DPR API
info.description: REST API of the APMSMEDC DPR tool. The API keeps no per-request state in the server: every call carries a short-lived bearer token (15 minutes), and sessions are renewed with the refresh cookie. All answers use the envelope `{ success, message?, data? }`. This file is generated from the route files.
